description: Paid (x402, 0.25 RLUSD) read-only decision product: computes PRO-LO multi-path coherence for a ticker — coherence = |Σ w·d| / Σ w across the signal paths (paths that cannot answer abstain and never vote) — and adds a Jev (TypeSafe AI) review. Verdict is PASS when consensus is non-flat, coherence >= 0.6, at least 2 paths agree, and the agreeing paths span at least 2 distinct data families (the trade composite and daily trend share the price series = one family); otherwise DENY, with a family-blocked DENY naming that reason. Jev review reports status unavailable when TYPESAFE_API_KEY is not configured — never simulated.

action.description: Optional proposed action this verdict is about (context, echoed back in the result)

claim.description: Optional claim or context being evaluated (echoed back in the result)

ticker.description: Stock ticker symbol (e.g. NVDA, AMC, GME)

name: coherence_jev_verdict
returns: JSON object with coherence, verdict (PASS | DENY), threshold, consensus, per_path_votes, and jev_review.
